plugins.name: acme-dns-cloudflare
plugins.description: wayhouse plugin that answers ACME DNS-01 challenges by setting and removing TXT records in Cloudflare DNS.

plugins.name: pelican
plugins.description: wayhouse plugin that routes hostnames to the Pelican panel's game servers: one entry node, no per-host DNS or firewall edits.

panel_host.title: Panel host
panel_host.description: Hostname of the Pelican panel, without scheme or path. The plugin may call this host (HTTPS, port 443) and nothing else.

host_template.title: Hostname template
host_template.description: Hostname per server: {identifier}, {id}, {name} or {external_id}, for example {identifier}.mc.example.com. Prefer {identifier} or {id}.

route_host.title: Claimable hostnames
route_host.description: The hostnames the plugin may route: an exact name or *.suffix, for example *.mc.example.com.

node_cidr.title: Node network
node_cidr.description: Network the Pelican nodes' addresses are in; routes pointing elsewhere are not allowed.

entry_ports.title: Entry ports
entry_ports.description: Entry port range wayhouse may assign to games without a hostname, lo-hi.

node_addresses.title: Node addresses
node_addresses.description: Node id to the address the entry node reaches it at; wins over the allocation's ip.

backend_ports.title: Backend ports
backend_ports.description: Ports a route may point at, lo-hi or one port. Set it: the node network limits addresses, not ports.
